learning_extracted: The lit-prescribed readout redefinition is validated: crf_frac_active (instantaneous active fraction) is the wrong persistence readout for a sparsely-matched differentiated pool (~0.016-0.031 in both e2ctx arms); maintained-and-reactivatable (crf_frac_maintained / crf_n_maintained_reactivatable) is the right one.

The activity-silent maintenance mechanism works and strictly dominates: it holds 62.5-100% of the differentiated pool vs 12.5-43.75% for differentiation-alone, clean monotone separation across all 3 seeds.

The 666a readiness gate used the wrong statistic: a COUNT floor (n_maintained>=2) is gap-density-sensitive and differentiation-alone clears it at the shorter behavioural-runtime context-absent gaps; the FRACTION statistic (crf_frac_maintained, already collected) isolates maintenance and should be the pre-registered gate.

This is the 3rd autopsy on the ARC-063 CRF-readiness target (654b -> 666 -> 666a) but it is convergent iterative substrate engineering, NOT claim-granularity debt: each step advanced (no-differentiation -> differentiation-works/persistence-collapses -> maintenance-works/gate-mis-stated); the substrate_ceiling claims were never weakened. No /claim-synthesis routing.
